description: Header sweep for the game's pre-check. Run 9eec49a9 showed the game drops every reply before its GCM verify (0x24D2500 never fired). Each entry is correctly sealed (key +0xCE, the game's prefix, server seq) and varies one header field: the command's top or low byte, the 12-byte body (the handoff's probe ids and u64s), or the footer. The whole set goes out in 4 bursts on game packets 1-4 and again on 5-8, inside the ~2 s the hardware-breakpoint trace survives. Any header that passes the pre-check shows up in relay/log/wfd.log as a 'GCM verify' line with its aad=.
